$comment: Which elements axe-core refuses a name on, for the stigmer/require-loading-region lint rule (tools/eslint-plugin-stigmer/rules/require-loading-region.js), which reports a busy, labelled element with no role written when its tag is in namelessElements. Measured, not judged: src/internal/__tests__/a11y/loading-region-markup.browser.test.ts renders every HTML element, busy, labelled, empty and with no role, through axe's aria-prohibited-attr in Chromium, and fails, printing what axe measured, when these lists disagree. Update a list by copying that output.

a.reason: an a with an href is a link, which takes a name; the rule cannot see an href passed in a spread

td.reason: a table cell takes a name inside a table; axe cannot judge one alone

th.reason: a header cell takes a name inside a table; axe cannot judge one alone
